title: Entergy Texas’ annual golf tournament hits fundraising record
summary: Entergy Texas’ 2026 Power to Care Golf Charity Classic raised more than $563,000, a record high that will help vulnerable customers facing financial hardship. The annual event held at The Woodlands Country Club-Palmer Course brought together 59 teams, 68 sponsors and dozens of volunteers to raise money for The Power to Care.
body_markdown:
Entergy Texas’ 2026 Power to Care Golf Charity Classic raised more than $563,000, a record high that will help vulnerable customers facing financial hardship.


The annual event held at The Woodlands Country Club-Palmer Course brought together 59 teams, 68


sponsors and dozens of volunteers


to raise money for The Power to Care. Through the program, local nonprofit agencies provide emergency bill payment assistance to seniors and disabled individuals.


“At its heart, this tournament is about showing up for the people who need us most—our seniors and folks with disabilities,”


said Ryan Magee, Entergy Texas’ director of public affairs. “


A completely sold-out event for the 4th consecutive year in a row shows we’re all committed to making a real difference.”


This year’s title sponsor was Kiewit, a partnership reflecting shared commitment to the event’s success and mission.


Through growth of the annual golf tournament and employee and customer giving, Entergy Texas’ The Power to Care program has reached record contributions. This year, well over $750,000 in funds helped more than 3,000


seniors and disabled individuals


avoid service interruption during times of crisis.


To make a donation or share assistance information with someone in need, visit


[The Power to Care](https://www.entergy.com/care) or


[https://www.entergytexas.com/residential/agencies](https://www.entergytexas.com/residential/agencies) .
